[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Arnth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the Sith [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where he trained fellow Imperials in the art of manufacturing [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]].
